# Getting Started with CompanyCam

Learn how to download CompanyCam, set up your account, invite your team, create a Project, and share photos with clients.

September 7, 2026

Table of contents

[Start here](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/14808615-getting-started-with-companycam#h_7667ee8b99)[Download the app](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/14808615-getting-started-with-companycam#h_418074a262)[Create your account](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/14808615-getting-started-with-companycam#h_28aa417d9b)[Invite your team](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/14808615-getting-started-with-companycam#h_095c1d5566)[Create your first Project](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/14808615-getting-started-with-companycam#h_03467ee684)[Take and upload photos](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/14808615-getting-started-with-companycam#h_f686256477)[Share with customers](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/14808615-getting-started-with-companycam#h_d53f622f6b)[Connect your other tools](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/14808615-getting-started-with-companycam#h_6fd119c738)[Learn more](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/14808615-getting-started-with-companycam#h_e71a84e16e)[FAQs](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/14808615-getting-started-with-companycam#h_70095c2100)

CompanyCam keeps every job photo organized by Project the moment it's taken. No more hunting through texts or camera rolls. Your whole team is on the same page from the field to the office.

* * *

# Start here

## Download the app

1. Open the App Store (iPhone) or Google Play Store (Android).

2. Search for **CompanyCam**.

3. Tap **Get** or **Install**.

4. Tap **Open** once it's finished.


* * *

## Create your account

In the mobile app, tap **Get Started for Free**. From here, enter your work email and password, then click **Get Started**. Then, follow the prompts to finish.

Or, to sign up on the web app, go to the CompanyCam [sign-up page](https://app.companycam.com/signup). Enter your work email and password, then click **Get Started**. Then, follow the prompts to finish.

![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2509481237/e0dc057762e15cc1bb907fb88ab3/Megan-s+Web+-2-.png?expires=1794208500&signature=b29e01a0800c90a90247cf19273c24844a542cd9dbc954357f5b92208503ab65&req=diUnH812nINcXvMW1HO4zUw5RAVwXokJ2WZw%2F1hovQqqwjFrRaDmHg5mX2s4%0AsuqZ4i3BSGzpSPpr4%2Bg%3D%0A)

* * *

## Invite your team

CompanyCam works best when your whole crew is in. [Invite employees](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/6828380-invite-new-users) so that they can upload photos and access Projects right away.

Go to **Team** \> **Invite Users**, enter their email addresses, and assign a permission role.

Note: Not sure which role to assign? See [User Permission Roles Explained](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/14010242-user-permission-roles-explained) for a full breakdown.

* * *

## Create your first Project

A Project keeps all photos, notes, and updates for a single job in one place. [Create a Project](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/6828373-create-a-new-project) for each job site, property, or customer.

1. Tap **\+ Create** on the Project feed and select **\+ New Project**.

2. Enter a project name, address, and any other details.

3. Tap **Create**.


* * *

## Take and upload photos

Inside your Project, tap the **Camera Icon** to [take a photo](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/12383831-take-photos-in-the-mobile-app) or tap **(+)** \> **Upload Photos** to [add existing photos](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/6828411-upload-existing-photos) from your device. Once photos are in, you can add descriptions, comments, or markup directly on them.

Turn on [date and time stamps](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/7045817-add-date-time-and-gps-coordinates-stamps-to-photos) in your settings to have them applied automatically to every photo taken through the app.

* * *

## Share with customers

Send clients a link to their job progress and cut the "can you send me an update?" calls for good.

|     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Option | What it does | Best for |
| [Gallery](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/6828401-how-to-share-photos-in-companycam#h_32f84e270d) | A curated set of photos shared via a static link. Clients can download photos from their end. | Sending a finished phase or closeout documentation. |
| [Timeline](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/6828401-how-to-share-photos-in-companycam#h_378a4df3c6) | A live link that updates as new photos are added. You control what's visible and can deactivate it at any time. | Keeping clients in the loop throughout a job. |
| [Photo Report](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/7048115-create-a-report) | A structured, formatted document with photos, comments, and descriptions organized into sections. | Formal deliverables, insurance, or anything that needs to look polished. |
| [Page](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/8695593-how-to-create-and-use-pages-in-companycam) | Flexible, formatted content with optional AI tools to help organize and write faster. | Client-facing summaries with more creative control. |
| [Guest Access](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/6828444-how-to-add-guest-access-on-projects) | A shared link that lets clients view updates, leave comments, and upload their own photos. No CompanyCam account required. | Homeowners or clients you want to keep closely involved. |

## Connect your other tools

CompanyCam has the ability to connect with the software you already use. Check out the full list of [integration opportunities](https://companycam.com/integrations), or explore the [open API and documentation](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/6828353-api-and-custom-integrations) if you want to build something custom.

# FAQs

### Can I use CompanyCam on a desktop?

CompanyCam is fully accessible at [app.companycam.com](https://app.companycam.com/) from any desktop or mobile browser. The mobile app is available on iOS and Android.

### Do my clients need a CompanyCam account to view shared photos?

Clients don't need an account to view a Gallery, Timeline, Report, or Page. Guest Access can also be used to view updates and add photos to a Project without an account.

### How many photos can I store in a Project?

CompanyCam doesn't limit the number of photos stored within a Project. Keep uploading and organizing as needed.

### Why can't my team member see a Project I created?

Your team member likely has [Restricted permissions](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/14010242-user-permission-roles-explained). Users with the Restricted permission role can only view Projects they're assigned to or Projects they create themselves.
